title: visor plugin protocol, version 1
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 between visor (the host) and a Plugin's process, one message per line (newline-delimited JSON) on the process's stdin and stdout. stderr isn't part of the protocol; its last line is shown when the process stops. The host starts one process per Plugin and addresses every Widget-specific message by its Widget id. Sequence: the host sends `initialize` and waits for its result; it then sends `widget/open` for each placed Widget, `widget/frame` when a Widget's size, focus or visibility changes, `widget/refresh` on its schedule, `action/choices` and `action/invoke` when the user runs an Action, and `widget/close` when a Widget goes away. The Plugin may send `widget/update` at any time. Closing stdin means quit. A result is checked against the matching $defs entry: initializeResult, refreshResult, choicesResult or invokeResult; this top-level schema checks the envelope and every request's and notification's params.

error.description: A failed request. For widget/refresh prefer a result with a status; for action/invoke, message is shown to the user as `<label> failed: <message>`.

widgetId.description: The Widget's id from config.toml, unique on the dashboard.

size.description: The Widget's inner size in cells, border excluded.

initializeParams.description: host → Plugin, request: the handshake. The Plugin answers with the protocol version it speaks; any other version than the host's puts the Plugin's Widgets in needs setup.

frameParams.description: host → Plugin, notification: how the Widget is shown. Sent when any of it changes.

visible.description: False while the user has hidden the Widget; hidden Widgets aren't refreshed.

openParams.description: host → Plugin, notification: a Widget of one of the Plugin's types was placed, with its settings (defaults filled in, durations as strings such as "5m") and how it's shown. A secret setting is in settings only once the user has set it; while a required one isn't set, the host shows the Widget in needs setup with its "Set <name>" Action and sends it no widget/refresh. Sent again, after a new initialize, when the process restarts, and for every Widget of the Plugin, with no widget/close first, when the user sets a secret.

widgetParams.description: host → Plugin: widget/refresh (request; answer with an update) and widget/close (notification).

updateParams.description: Plugin → host, notification: an update pushed at any time, such as a live view's new second or data that changed upstream.

update.description: New data and/or Status. A payload replaces what the Widget shows; a status other than ok keeps the data shown (marked stale) or, with none, shows the error.

state.description: ok; error (a failed fetch: message, a few words of reason for the stale marker, and a hint); setup (needs setup: message is the hint, action fixes it and becomes the primary Action); rate_limited (paused until `until`).

action.description: setup's fix: an Action of the Plugin's, or the id of one of the host's own, such as "secret:token" for the "Set token" Action of the Widget type's secret setting `token` (to send the user back to the prompt when the stored value is rejected). Naming a secret setting the Widget type doesn't declare is an error.

until.description: RFC 3339 time a rate limit lifts.

token.description: A theme token. Raw colours are rejected, so the user's theme recolours every Widget.

payload.description: What a Widget shows: a live view's styled lines, or a list's items under columns, optionally with summary lines above them. Either may carry Widget Actions.

lines.description: A live view's lines. In a list they are its summary, pinned above the items while the items scroll: a chart without rows takes 1 row there, center and wrap don't apply, and the whole summary is left out on a tile too short for it and one item row.

center.description: Centre the lines in the tile.

wrap.description: Word-wrap the lines and let the user scroll them.

columns.description: Makes the payload a list: every item has one field per column.

empty.description: Shown when the list has no items.

image.description: A PNG or JPEG the host draws in a live view, keeping its aspect ratio: as kitty graphics where the terminal has them, else as truecolor half-blocks. The host uploads each distinct image once and allocates its id. Lists leave it out, and wrapped lines wrap in the space it leaves. An unreadable path or undecodable data leaves it out while the lines still draw.

path.description: The file, relative to the Plugin's folder unless absolute. The host reads it again when a payload comes after it changed.

side.description: Where the image goes. left (the default) and right: the full body height, the lines in the width left after a one-cell gap, centred there with center; the image is left out when the lines would get narrower than 20 cells. top and bottom: the rows the lines leave, shared equally with charts without rows, at most the body width and centred across it; the image is left out under 3 rows.

digits.description: Draw the line's text as big digits (0-9, ':', '.', ',', '%', '-', space, A, B, G, K, M, P, T; lowercase letters draw as uppercase).

bar.description: Draw the span as an eighth-block bar instead of its text.

width.description: Cells; 0 takes what the line's other spans leave. In an item field, 0 takes what the field's other spans leave of a flex column, or 10 cells in any other column.

chart.description: A braille area chart, newest sample at the right edge.

priority.description: The highest-numbered columns are dropped first as the Widget narrows.

flex.description: Shares the width the other columns leave.

field.description: One item's spans in one column; a span's bar is drawn in the field too.

id.description: Stable across refreshes, so the selection follows the item.

group.description: Consecutive items with the same group share a header.

values.description: What the item is, by name, such as {"ticket": "GETT-123", "url": "https://…"}. Never drawn: the user's custom Actions in config.toml fill their {{name}} templates with them, so name the values a script would want.

rule.description: A line across the list before item `before`, such as a timeline's now-line.

hostActionId.description: The id of an Action the host owns and runs itself, never sending it to the Plugin as action/invoke. `secret:<name>` is the "Set <name>" Action the host adds to the Widget Actions of a Widget type with secret setting <name>: a masked prompt whose value it keeps in the OS keyring and sends in widget/open's settings, reopening every Widget of the Plugin.

id.description: Free-form; comes back in action/invoke. Ids starting `secret:` are the host's own (see hostActionId) and rejected on a Plugin's Action.

key.description: The key that runs it while the Widget is focused, as Bubble Tea prints keys: "a", "enter", "space", "ctrl+e". Host keys win; the Action stays in the ^K palette.

confirm.description: Ask first: the Action can't be taken back.

verb.description: open and copy are performed by the host with target (a URL to open, text to copy) and never sent to the Plugin.

input.description: What the host asks for first: text (a one-line prompt), inline (the multi-line editor over the Widget, prefilled with value), secret (a masked prompt whose value reaches only the Plugin: never drawn, toasted or logged), or choice (a menu filled by action/choices when the Action runs). The typed text or secret arrives as action/invoke's text, the picked choice as its choice. With text or secret input, target is a page the host opens as the prompt appears.

value.description: The text an input starts with; comes back as action/invoke's base.

choicesParams.description: host → Plugin, request: the choices of a choice Action, fetched when the user runs it (the menu shows a spinner meanwhile).

item.description: The selected item's id; absent for a Widget Action.

target.description: A page the host opens instead of invoking the Action, for a choice visor can't complete itself.

invokeParams.description: host → Plugin, request: run an Action.

item.description: The selected item's id; absent for a Widget Action.

text.description: The text typed or the secret entered.

choice.description: The id of the choice picked, for a choice Action.

base.description: The Action's value: the text an input started from.

invokeResult.description: A success. The host refreshes the Widget afterwards.

edit.description: A file the host opens in $EDITOR; the Widget refreshes when the editor exits.

then.description: The Action the host runs next, asking for its input first, so one Action leads into another (a setup flow's prompts). With edit, it runs once the editor exits cleanly, with text = the edit file.

settings.description: Settings the host writes into the Widget's [[widget]] block in config.toml (the old block commented out), checked against the manifest's settings; the Widget is then rebuilt with them. A secret setting can't be set this way.
